# CB Radio Antenna Mounting

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Select a mounting location that places the antenna above the roofline to minimize body blockage. [t1028]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Select a mounting location that places the antenna above the roofline to minimize body blockage.

_Procedure reported by [t1028]._

## Parts

- Antenna: Prefer a flexible antenna if using a stiff spring, or choose a shorter length. [t1028]
- Coax Cable: Consider an EZ Install cable with a Fire Ring connector to simplify routing. [t1028]
- [Partial] Grounding: Attach ground straps from the roof rack mount to the body and another from the body to the frame. [t1028]
- Mount: Options include drilling into the body, welding a mount to a tire carrier bumper, or clamping to the rear hatch. [t1028]
- [Partial] Spring: Use heavy duty for fiberglass antennas 4' or longer; use medium for shorter ones. [t1028]

## Specifications

- **Antenna Length (Heavy Duty Spring)**: 4' [t1028] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **Coax Cable Type**: Firestik MU-8R18 "2 Piece EZ Install" [t1028] ([Unverified] single report)
